minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, September 21, 2022
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 21, 2022.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Scott Snider, Lorraine Missick, Bette
  Donovan, Jenny Jolly, Rafaela Giles, and Edward Padgett.

  Members absent: None.

  Staff Present: Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist and Yvonne Duran,
  Community Services Manager.

  Guest present: None.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, August 17,
  2022 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program: For the Grab-n-Go meals, meals were distributed to an
  average of 136 participants per week in August.

  Congregate meals: Meals were served to an average of 18 participants per weeks in
  August.

  Meals on Wheels: 804 meals were served to 43 La Verne recipients in August.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of August was
  $2917.77. The flashboard was repaired but we would like an IT person from the city
  to determine if the telephone output can be converted to HDMI. This would allow the
  flashboard to be connected to the center’s computer and then project to the screen.
  The flashboard is obsolete without repair parts. We still have capability to show the
  called numbers and verify the winning games. The new boards from various
  companies are very expensive. They are large monitors with full capabilities. The
  average attendance each week is currently 54 players, which breaks even. 60
  players are needed each week to make money.

5. Account Balance: $6,044.09.
 6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Classes are going well. A “Life Skills” class was added for Those
  with Special Needs. The Senior classes have not changed.

8. Aging Next: Aging Next served 109 La Verne residents and gave presentations to
  five organizations/mobile homes in La Verne.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: The push button on the front door at center needs repair from the
  Stanley Door Service. The fire alarm system at the center is now fixed. Heritage
  contracting was awarded the work for the Veterans Hall kitchen remodel. The
  Aquatic Center will replaster the pool, replace decking, add permanent shade
  structures, and replace the 3-meter diving board.

10. Upcoming Events:
  • Tuesday, September 27th: Excursion: A Day in Manhattan Beach, 9:00 AM
  • Wednesday, September 28th: Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
  • Thursday, September 29th: Latin Line Dancing Party, 10:00 AM-12:00 PM
  • Friday, October 7th: Halloween Dance for People with Special Needs,
  5:00-8:00 PM
  • Monday, October 10th: Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  • Friday, October 14th: Senior Seminar, 9:30 AM
  • Saturday, October 15th: Trunk or Treat, 5:00-8:00 PM

11. Public Comments: Senior Advisory Committee will not meet in December.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 10:56 AM. Motion
  carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, October 21, 2022 at 10:00 AM.
